messages:
Nina (People Ops): FYI we pushed a minor handbook update this AM: 'Conflict of Interest disclosure' moved to the compliance section and a short compliance training was assigned. Please read and complete by Jun 5. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/coi.

Carlos M.: Quick Q: who gets the training? All full-time, temps, contractors?

Nina (People Ops): Everyone on payroll + contractors on SOW >= 30 days. Short-term vendors excluded unless they touch customer data. Added note in the handbook.

Harper (Legal): For recordkeeping we need manager-level exports of completions and a company master export saved to the compliance bucket after the deadline. Two year retention.

Recruiting Bot: automated: New hires with data roles will be auto-assigned "COI & Remote Data" on day 1. See onboarding runbook.

Carlos M.: Can managers request extensions for people on leave?

Nina (People Ops): Yes. Managers must file an HR ticket with dates and reason. We log approvals in the ticket system for audits.

LMS Bot: automated: Module assigned: "COI & Remote Data (2026)" to 162 users. Due: 1730428800 (Jun 5 2026). Progress: 0%.

Nina (People Ops): I created a tracking sheet for managers (edit access). Paste this header to import:

```
manager,employee_email,employee_id,status,completed_at,notes
```

Carlos M.: Nice. Will have my leads update it.

Harper (Legal): Also add a field for 'exemption_reason' so we can document contractors excluded from scope.

Nina (People Ops): Done. Thanks. I'll run an export after the deadline and send to legal.

Carlos M.: Thanks Nina. I'll remind my team in standup.

Nina (People Ops): Appreciate it. I'll post a short announcement in #all-hands later today.
